reason: Sunlight can evaporate river water, potentially continuing the water cycle.

effect: The water cycle completes the remaining goal and connects evaporation, precipitation and runoff through solar energy and gravity.
reaction: The closing explanation tied the steps together satisfyingly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the water cycle was most worthwhile because it connected the individual combinations into a continuing process.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making sediment was less rewarding on its own because the result had no explanation, though the subsequent delta clarified its role.

surprise.text: The distinction between invisible water vapor and the visible droplets or ice crystals in clouds clarified my understanding.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations had clear purposes, though their compatibility was supplied by the menu.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue for more concise explanations that connect familiar processes to how the world changes.
